literal_meaning: পথে দাঁড়ানো বা বসা (standing or sitting on the road)
figurative_meaning_en: To become penniless or completely destitute
example_sentences_in_bangla: জুয়া খেলায় সব হারিয়ে সে পথে দাঁড়িয়েছে।
ব্যবসায়ের লোকসানে তার পরিবার পথে বসেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He lost everything in gambling and ended up standing on the street.
His family became destitute due to business losses and sat on the roadside.
note: This idiom reflects the harsh realities of economic hardship in Bengali society, often linked to risky ventures like gambling.
